g.text: do you know where my On-lyne CD ended up?
I'm sure there's another in that CD store you hang out in.
if you need study material for that super ez hit pop song ur working on, all u need to do is ask
I'm getting the sense I hit a nerve with that whole four chord song thing.
Nah, I know what four chords on loop sound like already.
I figure u might have borrowed it <3 being a fan and all
Nope. Can you track it down with your metal powers?
You seem upset. Is it something I said?
do rats like shiny things? maybe Lettie's rat took it.
(Amir tells me there are no CDs in the future so)
Maybe the rat's an On-lyne fan too
Haha I actually think they do. Not sure they could carry a CD in their little paws though.
I didn't love being called boring.
I actually think it's cool how you see past the surface of pop music.
Look, we aren't all going to like the same things.
I don't think Zeke would approve of stealing. (No, I didn't take it. Lol.)
There are no CD players either, so even if I had it, I wouldn't be able to do much with it.
Oh... Well, metal makes a big comeback in the future
That's too bad. I'm out of ideas.
Oh. I really didn't mean anything by it.
Jokes aside, I really hope you find it.
Well, good luck with your search.
then I will dominate the future!
Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
You're not boring, Aoi. I just thought I was being clever.
If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
It seems the jury's convinced by your defense
What is it that upset you? I'm not judging. I really want to know.
No worries. Hope you find your CD.
and grants you a fresh start
hope u have a good day ^_^
well, nobody comes after punk songs for being three power chords, u know?
Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.
like sure, thrash out three chords and shout about making out with 10 blondes in a night. that's sooo cool. ur sooo real
but sing about being devoted to a girl? true luv? bringing people together at a party? now ur a sellout
uuh no offense to the 10 blondes. they can come to the party.
No, I get it. It's the double standard that bothers you.
I think you might be overthinking this.
yes! like I enjoy rock as much as the next girl, but let's not pretend it's less produced than pop
I just mean you should like whatever you like. Screw what everyone else thinks.
I'm not trying to offend you or anything.
Neither is better. They're just different flavors.
You've thought a lot about this.
True, and you deserve people in your corner who understand your point of view either way.
thx for the advice, I guess
i'm gonna get back to finding my CD. have a good one.
i'm gonna go. not trying to offend u or anything.
I'm gonna get back to finding my CD. thx for the chat
I'll do my best to be one of those people.
